senses.gloss:
प्रौढि प्रौढि, f., i. e.
 I. प्र-वह् + ति.
 1. Increase, Kathās. 14, 63.
 2. Elevation, Kathās. 21, 103 (in speech).
 3. Enterprize, confident or audacious [] exertion.
 II. प्र-ऊह् + ति, Investigation, discussion.

प्रौष्ठपद प्रौष्ठपद, i. e. प्रोष्थपद + अ.
 1. m. The month Bhādra, August--September.
 2. f. दी, Full moon in Bhādra, Man. 4, 95.
